result.summary: The page shows a few layout/content issues, mainly the 'Fastest near you' card row being cut off at the screen edge and a heart icon with low contrast on a light background.

issues.description: Third card 'Trattoria Piccol...' in 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, indicating horizontal scroll is not clearly indicated or content overflows without proper affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add partial card fade/gradient or scroll indicator to signal horizontally scrollable content, or adjust card width so it doesn't abruptly truncate text.

issues.description: Heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image is white on a dark background (fine), but on the pizza promo image below it appears black on a dark background making it low contrast and harder to see.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent icon color/background (e.g., semi-transparent white circle behind the heart) across all promo cards for better visibility.

issues.description: The second promotional card at the bottom is cut off by the navigation bar, showing only a partial pizza image with a '-100%' badge and no visible restaurant name or details.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card content lays out fully or add scroll padding so users can see restaurant name/details without excessive scrolling ambiguity.

issues.description: Notification bell icon has a small red dot indicator but no visible count or label, making it unclear how many notifications exist.
issues.suggestion: Add a numeric badge or accessible label (e.g., aria-label 'You have new notifications') for clarity.
